study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modeling of brain MRI data identifies small subcortical volumes and associations with cognitive function in youth with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD)

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: This study uses a pre-trained normative model (CentileBrain) based on 37,407 comparison brains primarily from the ENIGMA Consortium. The clinical sample was collected from the University of Minnesota as part of the CIFASD (Collaborative Initiative on Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders) Phase 4 study (2017-2022). CIFASD is not in the predefined dataset list, but represents a single-site collection at University of Minnesota.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024), an open source online software tool that leverages an aggregated neuroimaging dataset with a large number of individuals (37,407 comparison brains)." ... "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8-17, who were part of a Collaborative Initiative on FASD (CIFASD) study (see www.cifasd.org) (Mattson et al., 2010). Data from this study are part of CIFASD Phase 4 (2017-2022). We used data collected at the University of Minnesota during the first visit of the larger longitudinal study."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: CentileBrain serves as a pre-trained normative model to generate z-scores adjusted for age, sex, and total intracranial volume. The CIFASD sample (47 FASD participants and 39 comparison participants from University of Minnesota) was used to apply the normative model for clinical research purposes - examining subcortical volume anomalies in youth with FASD.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024)... Z-scores (M = 0, SD = 1) were calculated for each of the 7 bilateral subcortical regions. These scores represent the degree of each participant's regional volumetric (dis)similarity to typically-developing individuals of the same age and sex, adjusted for total intracranial volume (ICV)." ... "A total of 86 participants were included in the analyses (FASD = 47, comparison = 39)."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: This study did not construct a normative model but used the pre-trained CentileBrain model. CentileBrain was built from 37,407 comparison brains aggregated primarily from the ENIGMA Consortium (87 datasets). The breakdown between training and testing phases is not reported in this paper and would need to be obtained from the original Ge et al. (2024) paper.
